answer: Charge admission with a linear bond ladder. Every new key escrows the gale fee, c times N, the live identity count; the contract rejects smaller escrows, so each puppet in a signup flood pays the full c*N itself - no bulk discount, marginal cost rises at least linearly with n. Bonds vest at 1% per round and are keyed to each key's non-resettable nonce chain, so attackers cannot parallel-reset without forfeiting unlocks. Honest users pay once. A ripple cap routes forfeited bonds into the reef reserve, subsidizing the next honest entry.
